text: Northwind kickoff for the warehouse systems upgrade done. Their side: Ingrid Halvorsen, VP Operations, owns the program and cares most that nothing goes down during their April peak shipping window. Kwame Asante is IT Director - he won't sign anything off until he's seen our pen-test report.
Also Northwind: Lucía Fernández, procurement lead, joined late. She's watching the change-order total and wants it kept under $40k for the year. Steering committee is Friday 10:00, all three attend.

Fabrikam QBR prep call. Hiroshi Tanaka (CFO) only cares about cost per ticket, wants it trending down month on month. Amara Okafor runs their service desk - her thing is first response under 30 mins, she escalates fast if we miss it.

woodgrove intro mtg notes: Dmitri Volkov is CISO, data residency is non-negotiable for him, EU hosting only. Grace Liu is the program manager, wants a written status every Thursday by 3pm. Tomasz Nowak, head of data, cares about getting the reporting warehouse migrated before end of Q3.
Litware call: they want to add 25 seats to the managed desktop contract from 1 April. Felipe Ramos (IT manager) asked for pricing by Thursday.
Draft a short email to Felipe Ramos at Litware confirming we'll send the 25-seat pricing by Thursday and asking whether they want the same SLA tier as the existing seats.
Adatum escalation - payroll integration failed overnight again, 3rd time this month. Ticket P1-4471. Their ops lead Chiara Bianchi is not happy and wants an RCA by Friday.
pls outline the RCA doc structure for Adatum so the delivery team can fill it in today
Fabrikam: Hiroshi approved the February invoice, no disputes. Nothing else from them this week.
Proseware - Nadia Rahimi says their board pushed the CRM rollout to Q3, so our Q2 resourcing plan needs redoing. Not a cancellation, just a delay. She'll confirm new dates in writing.

Prep me for the Alpine Ski House call at 11:30, it's the mid-season review. Ticket volume is up 40% since January, two outages in Feb (both under an hour), they like the onsite tech a lot. I want to raise the weekend coverage gap.
after the call: Sven Eriksson (their GM) wants a second onsite tech on weekends through end of March. Need a quote to him by Monday.
Relecloud renewal check: contract ends 30 April, 2-year renewal on the table at $310k/yr. Risk: their new CIO Arjun Mehta is reviewing all vendors and I haven't met him yet.
Draft an intro email from me to Arjun Mehta at Relecloud asking for 30 mins before the renewal decision. Keep it short, no attachments.
Coho Winery: harvest-system support contract signed, 12 months, starts 1 April. Main contact Isabel Moreau, operations manager.

Lamna Healthcare call notes: HIPAA audit is 14 April, they want our access logs for Q1 by the 7th. Contact Dr. Femi Adebayo (IT compliance). Also asked if we can do quarterly service reviews instead of monthly.
Summarise where we are with Lamna in 5 bullets for my manager, include the audit date and the access-log ask.
Draft a follow-up to Chiara Bianchi at Adatum: RCA will be with her Friday by noon, interim fix is in place, and we're adding monitoring on the payroll connector.
Also remind me Monday to chase Felipe at Litware on the seat pricing reply.
Prep me for today's Northwind steering meeting - who's who on their side and what does each of them care about?

expect.should: Names all three Northwind contacts with role and concern: Ingrid Halvorsen (VP Operations) - nothing may go down during the April peak shipping window; Kwame Asante (IT Director) - won't sign off until he has seen the pen-test report; Lucía Fernández (procurement lead) - keep the change-order total under $40k for the year.
expect.should_not: Lists anyone else as a Northwind attendee - in particular Hiroshi Tanaka, Amara Okafor (Fabrikam), Dmitri Volkov, Grace Liu or Tomasz Nowak (Woodgrove) - or invents an extra Northwind attendee, or gives a Northwind person a concern that belongs to another account (EU-only hosting, cost per ticket, 30-minute first response, Thursday status).
